title: Axios Retry
description: Add retry logic to Axios requests for improved reliability.

data.text: axios-retry is an Axios plugin that automatically retries failed requests. It supports exponential backoff, configurable retry counts, and status-code-based retry logic.

data.title: Installation
data.code:
npm install axios-retry
# or
yarn add axios-retry

data.title: Basic Setup
Idempotency
data.text: Retrying non-idempotent requests like POST can cause duplicates. Use retries carefully for POST requests.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: axios-retry adds automatic retries to Axios
data.takeaway: Use axios-retry to make HTTP calls more resilient to transient failures.
